name: psyb0t
description: Agent skills and plugins from psyb0t projects.

plugins.name: aigate
plugins.description: Self-hosted AI platform combining inference routing, MCP tools, browser automation, and media generation behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

plugins.name: audiolla
plugins.description: Self-hosted audio-production API for stem separation, mastering, MIR analysis, DSP chains, MIDI, and AI restoration via REST and MCP.

plugins.name: claudebox
plugins.description: Runs Claude Code in a Docker container, drivable via CLI, HTTP REST API, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, MCP, Telegram, or cron.

plugins.name: codexbox
plugins.description: OpenAI Codex CLI in a Docker container, exposed via REST API, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, MCP, a Telegram bot, and a cron scheduler.

plugins.name: docker-mailbox
plugins.description: Multi-mailbox IMAP/SMTP control plane exposed as a REST API and MCP server on a single port for reading, searching, sending, and deleting mail.

plugins.name: flickies
plugins.description: Self-hosted video toolkit for lipsync, face restoration, and ffmpeg operations, exposed over REST and MCP.

plugins.name: goenv
plugins.description: Go library that reads the ENV environment variable and returns whether a process is running in prod or dev, defaulting to prod.

plugins.name: hybrids3
plugins.description: Self-hosted lightweight object storage over S3, plain HTTP, and MCP, with SQLite metadata, per-bucket keys, a master key, and presigned URLs.

plugins.name: ibkr-httpapi
plugins.description: HTTP+JSON bridge to Interactive Brokers via ib_async — market data, options/futures, account/positions, order entry, and server-side TA over REST and MCP.

plugins.name: mediaproc
plugins.description: Media processing over SSH — ffmpeg, sox, and ImageMagick for video/audio transcoding and image manipulation in a locked-down container.

plugins.name: mt5-httpapi
plugins.description: MetaTrader 5 trading via REST — market data, orders, positions, history, and server-side technical analysis.

plugins.name: persistent-sshfs
plugins.description: Bash tool that brings up SSHFS mounts, retrying key-based SSH auth until connected, then mounts with sshfs -o reconnect.

plugins.name: pibox
plugins.description: pi-coding-agent running in a container, exposed over HTTP REST, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, MCP, a Telegram bot, and a cron scheduler.

plugins.name: planesnitch
plugins.description: Self-hosted aircraft monitor that alerts on military, government, or custom-watchlist planes near your locations via Telegram or webhook, using free public ADS-B data.

plugins.name: predictalot
plugins.description: Self-hosted forecasting API — zero-shot time-series forecasting and supervised tabular ML over REST and MCP.

plugins.name: proxq
plugins.description: Redis-backed async HTTP proxy: submit any request, get a job ID instantly, poll for status, fetch the replayed upstream response.

plugins.name: qwenspeak
plugins.description: Self-hosted text-to-speech via Qwen3-TTS models over SSH, with preset voices, voice cloning, and voice design.

plugins.name: servicepack
plugins.description: Clone-and-own Go service framework: concurrent service manager with retry, dependency ordering, readiness gating, and CLI scaffolding.

plugins.name: ssh-tunnel-swarm
plugins.description: Bash tool that manages many concurrent SSH forward and reverse tunnels from a single rules file, with auto-reconnect and per-host keys.

plugins.name: stealthy-auto-browse
plugins.description: Stealth browser automation in Docker — Camoufox, OS-level input, HTTP API and MCP server for authorized anti-bot QA and security testing.

plugins.name: supervisor-config-gen
plugins.description: Bash script that generates a Supervisor (supervisord) program config file from the current directory, with zero CLI flags.

plugins.name: talkies
plugins.description: Self-hosted OpenAI-compatible speech API — ASR transcription (7 backends) and TTS synthesis (Kokoro, Qwen3-TTS voice cloning) over HTTP and MCP.

plugins.name: telethon-plus
plugins.description: HTTP + MCP control plane over a real Telegram MTProto userbot account — messages, dialogs, media, chat admin, polls, and an incoming-message webhook.

plugins.name: wickworks
plugins.description: Self-hosted OHLC service computing technical indicators and Smart-Money-Concepts primitives from candlestick bars via REST and MCP.
